text:
Sara - Support: FYI customer acme.co reports SSO failures after their IdP cert rotation tonight. Error we see: \"RecipientMismatch\" and logs show ACS URL not recognized. Trace: SAML-RT-8921. They insist ACS didn't change.

Tom - Eng: Can you paste the raw IdP metadata URL and a snip of the SP-configured entityID + ACS? Also any response headers from fetching metadata (302s etc).

Sara - Support: metadata URL: https://idp.acme.co/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml
SP config: entityID=https://app.redwood.com/saml/metadata, ACS=https://app.redwood.com/_saml/consume
We ran: `curl -I https://idp.acme.co/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml` -> got `HTTP/1.1 302 Found` then `Location: https://proxy.acme.co/idp/metadata.xml` and the final fetch succeeds but the returned XML has two <md:EntityDescriptor> entries. One is missing entityID attribute entirely (looks like a truncated publish).

Lee - SRE: That double-EntityDescriptor is interesting — SP libraries pick the first matching EntityDescriptor; if the first lacks entityID it can break selector logic. Can you paste the top of the XML? look for `<md:EntityDescriptor` lines.

Sara - Support: pasted top of file (redacted):
```
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<md:EntitiesDescriptor>
  <md:EntityDescriptor>
    <md:IDPSSODescriptor>... (no entityID attr here) ...</md:IDPSSODescriptor>
  </md:EntityDescriptor>
  <md:EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.acme.co/idp\">
    <md:IDPSSODescriptor>... keys ...</md:IDPSSODescriptor>
  </md:EntityDescriptor>
</md:EntitiesDescriptor>
```

Mina - Security: That explains RecipientMismatch — our SP code verifies the assertion recipient against the configured ACS and against the EntityDescriptor's listed AssertionConsumerService locations. If the metadata parser picks the first EntityDescriptor (with no entityID) it may not surface the ACS entries we expect. Also the cert rotation could have introduced a second EntityDescriptor during their rollout.

Tom - Eng: Two quick asks for repro: 1) can you reproduce locally by `curl` saving the metadata to file and pointing our test SP to it? 2) capture the exact SAMLResponse (base64) from their failing auth attempt so we can decode and inspect Recipient and InResponseTo. Steps:
- Ask customer to trigger SSO and paste header `SAMLResponse` (base64) or give a network capture.
- Or run our proxy test: `SAML_DEBUG=1 REDWOOD_SP_TEST_METADATA=/tmp/metadata.xml ./run-local-sp.sh` after `curl -o /tmp/metadata.xml https://idp.acme.co/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml`.

Sara - Support: Customer uploaded logs and SAMLResponse (base64). Attached here (pasted decoded snippet):
```
<Assertion Recipient=\"https://app.redwood.com/_saml/consume\" ...>
  <Issuer>https://idp.acme.co/idp</Issuer>
  <Subject>user@acme.co</Subject>
</Assertion>
```
But SP rejected: `recipient mismatch: metadata acs list []` (empty).

Lee - SRE: That matches parser returning empty ACS list because it selected the empty EntityDescriptor. Workarounds: 1) Ask IdP to remove the placeholder/truncated EntityDescriptor, 2) We can update our metadata fetcher to prefer EntityDescriptor with entityID attribute, but that's a code change (low-risk). For immediate workaround we can point the customer's SP to a manually fixed metadata file (hosted on their side or on a temporary signed URL).

Mina - Security: Before we host any customer metadata we should sanity-check the keys (thumbprints) and only accept known-good cert. Also confirm the customer's rotation used dual-key rollout (old+new present). If so, we should accept both signing keys while the round finishes.

Sara - Support: Customer confirms they rolled with dual key and a custom publish job accidentally included an extra EntitiesDescriptor wrapper that put a blank EntityDescriptor first. They've already reverted the publish in their staging but prod still shows the bad metadata due to CDN caching (proxy.acme.co returns 302 -> CDN).

Tom - Eng: Quick repro I ran locally: saved their metadata, our parser returned first EntityDescriptor w/o entityID which caused ACS list to be empty. Patch idea: prefer EntityDescriptor elements that have `@entityID` set and contain at least one AssertionConsumerService. I'll open a PR to add a parser fallback.

eng-oncall: Created internal incident and escalation SR-2026-4453 (P2). Action items:
- Sara: coordinate with customer to purge CDN and re-publish corrected metadata.
- Tom: prepare a small parser fallback release (patch branch `saml-metadata-fallback`).
- Mina: validate keys from the corrected metadata, confirm thumbprints.
- Lee: add regression test that parses EntitiesDescriptor with empty EntityDescriptor first.

Sara - Support: Customer will purge CDN and ping when propagation done. Temporary mitigation: customer uploaded fixed metadata to https://files.acme.co/redwood-fix/metadata.xml and asked us to point to it. Mina — want us to fetch and validate before switching?

Mina - Security: Yes please fetch and validate. Check that `KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\"` thumbprint matches one of the keys in the original rotation plan. If OK we can point their tenant at the temporary URL for now.

Tom - Eng: I'll prepare the patch and a candidate hotfix build. If customer needs immediate unblock we can point to their temp URL after Mina signs off. Also add a quick parser heuristic: ignore empty EntityDescriptor (no attributes and no IDP/SP descriptors) when selecting entity metadata.

Sara - Support: updating ticket SR-2026-4453 with steps, attaching decoded SAMLResponse and original metadata. Will update when CDN purge completed. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: Metadata change detected for idp.acme.co at 2026-05-07T23:07:22Z (new file size, 12KB). Noted on SR-2026-4453.

eng-oncall: keeping thread open until prod metadata corrected and SR closed.
